book.name: Mɑteu
book.title: LABAARI GEA NGE MƐ MATEU U YORUA

content: Yesu u wi u bɑrɑ disiɡiru bɑrɔ bɛkiɑ
Ye Yesu u sɑrɑ ɡuu ten min di, tɔn wɔrusu nùn swĩi.
Mɑ durɔ ɡoo wi u bɑrɑ disiɡiru bɑrɔ u nɑ u kpunɑ win wuswɑɑɔ u nɛɛ, tɔnwero, ɑ̀ n wurɑ kɑɑ kpĩ ɑ mɑn bɛkiɑ kpɑ n dɛɛrɑ.
Yesu u win nɔmu dɛmiɑ u nùn bɑbɑ mɑ u nɛɛ, nɑ wurɑ, ɑ bɛkuro kpɑ ɑ dɛɛrɑ. Mii mii u bɛkurɑ u dɛɛrɑ sɑɑ win bɑrɑrun di.
Mɑ Yesu u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ nɔɔmɔ? A ku ɡoo yeni sɔ̃, ɑdɑmɑ ɑ doo yɑ̃ku kowon mi u nun mɛɛri, kpɑ ɑ yɑ̃kuru ko te Mɔwisi u yiire. Nɡe mɛyɑ kɑɑ kɑ bɑɑwure sɔ̃ɔsi mɑ ɑ dɛɛrɑ.
Yesu u tɑbu sunɔ ɡoon yoo bɛkiɑ
Ye Yesu u duɑ wuu ɡɑɡu sɔɔ ɡe bɑ rɑ soku Kɑpenɑmu, tɑbu sunɔ ɡoo dɑ u kɑ nùn yinnɑ mɑ u nùn fɑɑbɑ kɑnɑ
u nɛɛ, tɔnwero, nɛn yoo u bɑrɔ yɛnuɔ, bɑɑ nɔmɑ u ku rɑ kpĩ u yĩiyɑ, u nɔni sɔ̃ɔre ɡem ɡem.
Mɑ Yesu u nɛɛ, yɑ wɑ̃, kon dɑ n nùn bɛkiɑ.
Tɑbu sunɔ wi, u wisɑ u nɛɛ, ɑɑwo nɑ ǹ turɑ ɑ du nɛn yɛnuɔ. A ɡesi ɡɑri ɡeruo, nɛn yoo u koo bɛkurɑ.
Nɛn tii nɑ rɑ ɡɑbu wiru kpĩiyɛ, mɑ nɑ tɑbu kowobu mɔ be nɑ kpɑre. Nɑ̀ n turo sɔ̃ɔwɑ u doo, u rɑ n dɔɔwɑ. Nɑ̀ n ɡoo sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɑ, u rɑ n sisiwɑ. Nɑ̀ n mɑɑ nɛn yoo sɔ̃ɔwɑ u yeni koowo, u rɑ n mɔ̀wɑ.
Ye Yesu u ɡɑri yini nuɑ, u biti kuɑ mɑ u tɔmbu sɔ̃ɔwɑ be bɑ nùn swĩi u nɛɛ, kɑ ɡem nɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ, nɑ ǹ ɡoo wɑɑre bɑɑ Isirelibɑ sɔɔ wi u nɑɑnɛ doke binin bweseru mɔ.
Nɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ mɑ tɔn dɑbirɑ koo nɑ sɑɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yeru kɑ duu yerun di kpɑ bu sinɑ bu di mi Gusunɔ u bɑndu swĩi kɑ Aburɑhɑmu kɑ Isɑki kɑ Yɑkɔbu sɑnnu.
Adɑmɑ be, be n weenɛ bɑ n wɑ̃ɑ mi, bɑ koo bu kɔ̃ tɔɔwɔ yɑm wɔ̃kuru sɔɔ mi bɑ koo wiru nɔmɑ sɔndi bu swĩ.
Mɑ Yesu u tɑbu sunɔ wi sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, u doo yɛnuɔ. Ye u nɑɑnɛ doke kpuro yɑ koo nùn koorɑ. Mɑ sɑɑ ye sɔɔ mii mii, tɑbu sunɔ win yoo wi, u bɛkurɑ.
Yesu u tɔn dɑbinu bɛkiɑ
Yesu u dɑ Piɛɛn yɛnuɔ. Mɑ u deemɑ Piɛɛn kurɔn mɛro u wɑsi sundu bɑrɔ u kpĩ.
Yesu win nɔmu bɑbɑ mɑ wɑsi sun te, tɑ yɑrinɑ. Mɑ u seewɑ u nùn nɔɔri.
Dɔmɑ ten yokɑ, bɑ kɑ tɔn dɑbinu nɑ be bɑ wɛrɛkunu mɔ. Yesu u wɛrɛku ni ɡirɑ kɑ ɡɑri ɡerubu tɔnɑ, mɑ u kpuro bɛkiɑ be bɑ bɑrɔ.
U yeni kuɑ kpɑ Gusunɔn sɔmɔ Esɑin ɡɑri yi kɑ koorɑ, yi u nɛɛ, “Win tii u bɛsɛn wɑsin dɑm sɑriru suɑ, mɑ u kɑ bɛsɛn bɑrɑnu doonɑ.”
Be bɑ kĩ bu Yesu swĩi
Ye Yesu u tɔn wɔrusu wɑ si su nùn sikerenɛ, mɑ u nɛɛ, bu de bu dɑ dɑɑ burerun ɡuruɔ.
Sɑnɑm mɛyɑ woodɑ yɛ̃ro ɡoo u nɑ win mi, u nɛɛ, yinni, kon nun swĩi yɑm kpuro mi ɑ dɔɔ.
Yesu u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, sɛmusu bweusu mɔ, ɡunɔsu su mɑɑ sokunu mɔ. Adɑmɑ nɛ Tɔnun Bii nɑ ǹ nɛn tii ɑyeru ɡɑru mɔɔwɛ mi kon kpunɑ.
Yesun bɔ̃ɔ ɡoo u mɑɑ ɡeruɑ u nɛɛ, yinni, ɑ de n ɡinɑ dɑ n nɛn tundo sike.
Yesu u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ mɑn swĩiyɔ, kpɑ ɑ de ɡɔribu bu ben ɡɔribu sike.
Yesu u nim kurenu mɑrisiɑ
Yesu u ɡoo nimkuu duɑ mɑ win bwɑ̃ɑbɑ nùn swĩi ɡe sɔɔ.
Yɑnde mɑ woo bɔkɔ ɡɑ seewɑ dɑɑ bure te sɔɔ, sere nim kurenu nu ɡoo ɡe wukiri. Adɑmɑ Yesu u do.
Bwɑ̃ɑ be, bɑ dɑ bɑ nùn yɑmiɑ bɑ nɛɛ, Yinni ɑ sun fɑɑbɑ koowo sɑ kɑm kobu dɔɔ.
Yesu u nɛɛ, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ i bɛrum mɔ̀, bɛɛ nɑɑnɛ doke piibuɡibu. Mɑ u seewɑ u woo kɑ nim kure ni yiire nu mɑri mɑ n mɑri sɔ̃ɔ sɔ̃ɔ.
Be kpuro bɑ biti kuɑ bɑ nɛɛ, durɔ weren bweserɑ wini. Bɑɑ woo kɑ nim kurenu mɑm nu nùn mɛm nɔɔwɑmmɛ.
Yesu u wɛrɛkunuɡibu yiru bɛkiɑ
Yesu u turɑ Gɑdɑrɑn temɔ dɑɑ bure ten ɡuruɔ, mɑ durɔbu yiru ɡɑbɑ kɑ nùn yinnɑ be bɑ yɑrimɑ sikɑn di. Durɔ be, bɑ wɛrɛkunu mɔ bɑ sɛ̃ ɡem ɡem sere ɡoo ku rɑ kɑ̃ku u swɑɑ ye sĩ.
Mɑ bɑ yɑnde ɡbɑ̃rɑ bɑ nɛɛ, mbɑ n sun mɛnnɛ bɛsɛ kɑ wunɛ Gusunɔn Bii. A nɑwɑ ɑ kɑ sun tɔ̃yɑ ko sɑɑ yu sere turi?
Bɑ kurusɔ wuu bɑkɑru ɡɑru wɛndɛ sɑ̃ɑ tɑ dimɔ.
Wɛrɛku ni, nu Yesu kɑnɑ nu nɛɛ, ɑ̀ n kɑɑ sun ɡirɑ ɑ de su du kurusɔ ni sɔɔ.
Yesu u nɛɛ, i doo. Ye nu yɑrɑ mɑ nu dɑ nu duɑ kurusɔ ni sɔɔ. Yerɑ kurusɔ wuu te kpuro tɑ duki sɑrɑmɑ ɡuurun di tɑ wɔri dɑɑ bure te sɔɔ, tɑ nim diirɑ.
Durɔ be bɑ rɑɑ kurusɔ ni kpɑrɑmɔ, bɑ duki doonɑ wuu sɔɔ. Mɑ bɑ tɔmbu ɡɑri yi kpuro sɔ̃ɔwɑ kɑ ye n wɛrɛkunuɡii be yiru deemɑ.
Mɑ wuu ɡen tɔmbu kpuro bɑ yɑrɑ bɑ Yesu sennɔ dɑ. Ye bɑ nùn wɑ bɑ nùn suuru kɑnɑ bɑ nɛɛ, u yɑrio ben tem di.
